Reading the whole conversation, the customer asked two things: contest the $840 shop supplies charge (billing) and arrange a lease return inspection. The last message says "Yes please book," which confirms the lease inspection booking. But the main issue is unclear, so I need to decide which type is primary.

The customer's first message wants to "understand or remove" the charge, so it is contested. The agent said it would have an advisor confirm and remove it if not quoted, but removing an invoice charge is something only the service manager can change. The customer contests the charge and wants it removed, which fits policy_limit.

The latest message is about booking the inspection. The inspection is a lease return inspection, so lease_end_return fits better than book_service. The billing dispute is the first and more substantive issue, though, so I'll make it the main type and put lease_end_return in secondary_types.
